info.title: DimonSmart DbSketch
info.description: Generate database schema diagrams from live SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL databases as Graphviz DOT, Mermaid, or Markdown.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate database schema diagrams from live databases.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Read a live database schema and generate a diagram.

options.name: --diagram
options.description: Generate only the named diagram from config.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only errors. Do not print progress messages. [default: False]

options.name: --no-progress
options.description: Do not print progress messages, but still allow non-progress warnings/errors. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Read schema and apply config, but do not write output. [default: False]
